text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Dad. For letting me use 
the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all. In fact, it makes me 
happy that you still want to dance with 
me."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ballet is where it all began for me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to carve it deep into my heart. The 
burning passion to take center stage that 
I felt back then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On her day off, Win Variation practiced 
steps at her father's ballet studio. 
Thanks to that, it seems she's regained 
her vigor.
